subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2836
title: Requires a statement of economic interest to be filed by all members of the board of directors or governing body of a nonprofit that has either received or submitted testimony to the Legislative Assembly requesting $1 million or more in state capital construction funding over the previous five years.
headline: HB 2836 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2836 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2836 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
